description: Source-backed UI corrections. Shared declarations are listed per affected selector/state; these are not a claim of 500 independent functional bugs. No repeated font-size replacements are included.

entries.issue: Remove the permanent circular ship background
Remove the permanent circular ship border
Remove the card shadow from the ship
Keep a transparent touch hitbox around the glyph
Make clicking the ship pulse instead of launching Flight
Prevent ship pointer-down from dragging the world
Prevent ship double-click from entering entertainment
Describe the actual pulse action to assistive technology
Disable the ship during travel and mode transitions
Remove the occluded ship from the tab sequence
Prevent clicks on the ship behind the sphere
Replay pulse feedback on every click
Use a single short pulse rather than an infinite ring
Respect reduced motion for ship feedback
Match the ship glyph to light and dark mode
Keep the glyph centered in the invisible hitbox
Remove fabricated recent-signal rows from the command home
Move duplicate center rows into the System subview
Make the command home a contained card
Reduce the default command home height
Separate command footer actions from quick actions
Remove the extra center-category label above each landmark
Avoid repeating readiness text beside every landmark
Increase the contrast of landmark names in light mode
Remove the solid rectangle behind the Orbit center label
Remove the center label dark text-shadow in light mode
Reduce inspector content when no destination is selected
Keep zoom and navigator controls inside the inspector width
Remove the default inspector card shadow
Collapse the left card on small screens with an accessible details control
Keep the details expansion inside the available viewport
Move quick locations away from the bottom route rail
Keep floating pins readable without repeating generic subtitles
Stop displaying a hardcoded ten-location count
Describe route availability rather than claiming a live connection
Use consistent surface tokens in the header chips
Hide decoration on a small screen rather than clipping controls
Improve the spacing between the world and navigation chrome
Wait for the collapse before swapping landmark labels
Stop automatic world rotation during the transition
Stop ship orbiting during the transition
Darken the world during the opening half-second
Collapse existing sphere points into the center
Reform the same sphere points after the midpoint
Stage DIRECTION IS OVERRATED before the entertainment title
Stage GIVE YOUR LIFE ENTERTAINMENT after the midpoint
Reverse the sequence with ALRIGHT BACK TO WORK
Prevent rapid double-clicks from stacking transition timers
Cancel the midpoint timer when Orbit unmounts
Cancel the completion timer when Orbit unmounts
Use a short static transition for reduced motion
Keep the source landmarks out of keyboard navigation while collapsing
Reveal colored game landmarks after reforming
Keep entertainment colors independent of the selected personal accent
Make the dark entertainment world work when the app is in light mode
Label the current games as prototypes awaiting rebuild
Prevent unfinished games from claiming to be ready-to-play
Provide an explicit accessible return-to-direction control
Keep prototype information in a dismissible focus-contained dialog
Restore focus after closing prototype information
Stop the first center click from recentering before a double-click
Replace the long crowded expansion with a bounded controls tray
Keep the tray inside the viewport width
Group tray controls into a legible responsive grid
Remove duplicate ARROW wordmarks inside the tray
Keep the header lockup visible when the tray opens
Bridge the pointer gap between trigger and tray
Delay hover closure so the tray can be reached
Cancel delayed closure when the pointer returns
Close the tray on Escape before navigating to another center
Restore focus to the tray trigger when Escape closes it
Give the tray an independent surface and border
Keep small-screen tray controls reachable without horizontal scrolling
Give every packaged stylesheet a content-based revision
Give every packaged script a content-based revision
Validate every exported HTML page instead of six sample entry pages
Emit a versioned center manifest for the beta bundle
Include the username help route in package validation
Check that beta guards are present on every center entry page
Keep beta assets inside the Resonant-Relay path
